async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Reports' link in the menubar to open the menu
    reports_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="\ue64a Reports")
    await reports_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait briefly for menu to appear
    # Navigate to the 'Orders' report under the Reports menu
    # Based on the tree, the 'Orders' link is under nested menus: menubar -> link -> menu -> menu -> menu -> link
    # Use filtering to locate the correct link
    orders_link = page.get_by_role("menu").filter(has=page.get_by_role("menu").filter(has=page.get_by_role("menu").filter(has=page.get_by_role("link", name="Orders"))))
    await orders_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
